    The selection in Fischbacher's reduction lemma #

    Fix a point b of a finite, chain-bounded ray category with cancellation. R₀ consists of the arrows from b and the values of essential contours starting at b; R is the component of R₀ (for comparability in the prefix order) containing a fixed arrow β. This file develops the combinatorics of R used to choose the arrows αᵢ and the path u of Fischbacher's Lemma 2.1.
